mentions.name: LawVM
mentions.description: This tool treats legislative amendment statutes as programs and verifiably replays them to obtain actual consolidated (current) law as it stands, surfacing ambiguity where present. It is a compiler suite covering Finland, Estonia, UK, Sweden and Norway to start with, with a full release planned after cleanup. It does not use AI at all except during development.
mentions.problem: In Finland there is no way to know what the law actually says: the "official" consolidated law is not official, and manual compilation/consolidation can contain errors (the author found hundreds), leaving people doing it themselves while courts decide based only on original statutes.
mentions.source_excerpt: I call it LawVM - interpret amendment statutes as "programs" and verifiably replay them to obtain actual consolidated i.e. current law as it stands (or where ambiguous, surface that)
